title: Planning Mode

discardConfirm.title: Discard Planning Session?
discardConfirm.description: This will permanently delete all messages and progress in this planning session. This action cannot be undone.

noActiveSessionDescription: Start a new planning session to begin structured planning with BMAD methodology.

bmad.name: BMAD
bmad.description: Business-driven Modular AI Development - A structured approach to planning with Brief, PRD, Architecture, Epics, and Stories.

sessionSelector.title: Planning Sessions
sessionSelector.emptyDescription: Start a new planning session to begin.

recovery.title: Resume Previous Session?
recovery.description: You have an in-progress planning session that was interrupted.
recovery.discardConfirm: Are you sure you want to discard this session? This action cannot be undone.

chat.startConversationDescription: Describe what you want to build, and I'll help you create a structured plan following the BMAD methodology.
chat.inputPlaceholder: Describe your project or ask a question...
chat.inputHint: Press Enter to send, Shift+Enter for new line

suggestions.whatProject: What project would you like to plan?
suggestions.helpDefine: Help me define my product vision
suggestions.needPRD: I need to create a PRD

artifacts.title: Artifacts
artifacts.emptyDescription: Artifacts will appear here as you progress through the planning workflow.
artifacts.editorPlaceholder: Enter artifact content in Markdown format...
artifacts.discardDescription: You have unsaved changes. Are you sure you want to discard them?

review.title: Review Required
review.description: "{{title}}" is ready for your review. Please approve, request revisions, or reject.
review.revisionDescription: Describe what changes you'd like to see in this artifact.
review.revisionPlaceholder: Enter your feedback and revision requests...

stories.title: Stories
stories.editPlaceholder: Edit story content in Markdown format...
stories.unsavedChangesMessage: You have unsaved changes to this story. Do you want to discard them?

clarityTest.label: Clarity Test
clarityTest.explanation: The clarity test: Could you implement this story yourself based only on its description and acceptance criteria? If yes, it's ready. If not, it needs more detail.

convert.confirmMessage: This will create Kanban tasks for {{count}} ready stories. The stories will be marked as 'In Progress'.
convert.resultsMessage: Some stories had issues during conversion:
convert.duplicateMessage: A task for "{{title}}" already exists. What would you like to do?

sprints.title: Sprints
sprints.selectSprint: Select a sprint to view its queue
sprints.noTasksInSprint: No tasks in this sprint. Assign tasks from the story list or task board.

execution.title: Sprint Execution
execution.confirmStartDescription: This will automatically execute {{count}} pending stories. The sprint will continue even if some stories fail.
execution.confirmStopDescription: The current story will complete, then execution will stop. You can resume later.

failure.retryConfirm: Reset this story to pending and re-queue for execution?

share.title: Share Planning Artifacts
share.formatMarkdown: Markdown (.md) - Plain text, easy to share
share.feedbackNote: Share these artifacts with stakeholders for feedback. Ask them to provide suggestions via email or your preferred communication tool.
